label: Experimental · Fast paired gait · 25 mm/s
description: Command-driven opposite-leg pairs. Hold W/S for forward/reverse; combine W or S with A/D for walking turns. Stop finishes an airborne transfer. No turn-in-place or lateral motion.
readiness: Experimental: slip and realtime latency gates remain unmet.
evidence: 20 s native steering trial: 27.1 mm/s forward, 24.9 mm/s reverse. Explicit 5 ms approximation differs by at most 1.46 mm body position from the 1.25 ms reference. Ideal joint observations; uncalibrated CAD physics. Browser measurements pending.
